paite: Khopi helhat leh buah, nuaisiah ching tung agik hi!
heading: Jerusalem Khelhna Leh Tatna

paite: Kuamah thu angaikhe kei a, bawlhoihna leng asang thei kei. amuanna leng TOUPA ah a-om kei a; a Pathian anaih sam kei hi.
Asung a aheutu liante uh humpinelkai humham ahi ua, avaihawmte uh lah nitaklam ngehon, azingchiang a nek ding nuse ut lou bang ahi uh.
Azawlneite uh lah mizuauthei leh lepchiah ahi ua; asiampute un mun siangthou ahihbuah ua, dan tung ah ahiamgam uhi.
Asung ua TOUPA bel adiktat a; thil thulim lou ahih kei ding; zingsang teng in avaihawm khovak ah alak a, avuaksuak ngei kei a; himahleh midiktatloute'n zaw zumna athei kei uhi.
Namte ka satkheta a, a-insangte uh akisegawp hi; akongzingte uh ka susia a, kuamah apai kei uhi; akhopite uh hihsiat in a-om a, huchi a mi kuamah om lou in, ateng leng a-om kei uhi.

Chihtaktak in kei na hon kihta ding ua, bawlhoihna na kipahpih ding, ka chi a; huchi in atenna satkhiak in a-om kei dia, amah tungtang a sehsa tengteng bang in; himahleh beltak in athou ua, ahih tengteng uh asesak uhi.

"Huaiziak in mat ding zuan a ka thoh ni atun masiah hon na ngak un," TOUPA'N achi. Namte kaihkhawm ka tup ahi ngal a, lalgamte ka suktuah a atung ua ka hehna ka sunbuak theihna ding in, ka thangpaihna lauhuai tengteng; ka mullitna mei a leitung pumpi nekgaih a om ding lah ahi ngal a.
Huai hun chiang a mite'n TOUPA min aloh ua, thukhat sat a amah nna aseptheihna ding un, akiang uah muk siangthou ka pe ding hi.
Ethiopia luite khen lam a kipan gimlim hal mite, dalhsa ka mite tanu mahmah in ka thillat ahon tawi ding hi.

Huai ni chiang in ka tung a na tatlekna, na thilhihte tengteng ziak in na zahlak kei ding; huai hun chiang a na lak a na mikisathei leh ki-uangsakte lakhe ding ka hih ziak in, huchi in ka tang siangthou ah na ki-uangsak nawnta kei ding uhi.
Himahleh na lak ah mi gimthuak leh genthei ka nuse ding a, TOUPA ah amuang ding uhi.
Israel khosuaksunte'n gilou ahih kei ding ua, zuau agen sam kei ding uh; akam uah leng lei khemhat akimu kei ding hi; ne a, lum a, amaute kuamah in ahihlau louh ding ziak un.
La sa in, Aw Zion tanu; kikou in, aw Israel! Jerusalem tanu aw, na lungtang tengteng toh kipak inla, nuamsa in!
heading: Kipahna La

paite: TOUPA'N na vaihawmnate alamangta a, na melma adelhkhia a, na lak ah Israel kumpipa, TOUPA a-om hi; gilou na lau nawn kei ding hi.
Huai ni chiang in, Jerusalem kiang ah, "Lau ke'n," chih ahi ding; Aw Zion, na khutte ze-olsak ke'n.
Na lak ah TOUPA na Pathian a-om hi, hondam ding mihat; na itna ah akhawl ding, la sa in na tung ah anuam ding hi.
Khawmpi kulmut ziak a dahnate, noute a dia puakgik leh gensiatna hiite ka lamang ding hi.

Ngai in, huai hun chiang in, nang hihgimte tengteng ka bawl ding a, panpih kiphamohnu ka hondam ding a, hawlmang a omnu ka lakhawm ding; huchi in leitung pumpi a azahlakna uh ana omkhitnate ah, phatna leh minthanna amaute ka pe ding hi.

Huai hun chiang in ka hon la nawn ding a, huai hun chiang in nou ka hon kaikhawm ding hi; na mitmuh ua na saltanna ua kipan ka hon pi nawn hun chiang in, lei a mi tengteng lak ah min leh phatna in nou ka hon bawl ding, TOUPA'N achita hi.
